verdict.rationale: kitty is scriptable rather than a native automation runner. Its remote-control interface lets external scripts open windows, send text and read output, and kittens extend it in Python. A hands-on probe confirmed a detached kitty instance can be driven end-to-end over a socket by `kitten @` commands. Anything autonomous or background must come from external scripts or schedulers driving that control layer. Missing for 10: built-in scheduling or trigger-based automations, native background job or agent execution, documentation of autonomous unattended workflows.
